title: WhatsApp — Group Messaging
subtitle: Fan-out on write with Sender Keys

panels.title: Sender Keys Protocol
panels.body:
- Sender generates 1 symmetric key
- Shares with all group members
- Encrypts message ONCE
- Members decrypt with sender key

panels.title: Large Groups
panels.body:
Hybrid approach: Push for online,
Pull for offline to avoid storage
amplification (N-fold writes).
